div.ab: for ðam þe ealle biscopas secgað, þæt hit swyþe deop wið God to betanne, þæt man aðas oððe wedd tobrece.
For ðam þe ealle biscopas secgað þæt hit swyþe deop wið God to betanne þæt man aðas oððe wedd tobrece.
Forðam þe ealle biscopas secgað þæt hit swyþe deop is wið God to betanne þæt man aðas oððe wedd tobrece.
weil alle Bischöfe sagen, dass es sehr tief gegenüber der Kirche gebüsst werden [müsse], wenn man Eide oder rechtsförmliche Versprechen verletzt.
because all the bishops say that it [must] be atoned for very deeply before God if oaths or pledges are broken.
For all the bishops declare that very severe amends must be made to God for the violation of oaths or pledges.
For all the bishops say that the breaking of oaths and pledges is to be very deeply atoned for with God.
for all the bishops decree that very great penance must be performed before God for the violation of oaths or pledges.
